name: DetailsPageWithTabs
title: Templates/Platform/Shell/DetailsPageWithTabs
summary: The Overview tab of a resource detail page: the platform shell with the resource breadcrumb, the full-bleed tab bar, then the column that opens on the resource summary card. The resource overview follows it with Get started for a resource made from the CLI, and the same page plots its Versions tab (the versions table) and its Build tab (repository, build configuration and token bands); the service overview ends its breadcrumb on the environment picker and follows the summary with the production checklist and the deployment topology. A policy’s summary card on its own is the DetailsPage template. The deployment page sits in the same shell without tabs: a status banner, the Deployment Details card with its Deployment Settings band, and the Deployment Logs card whose header carries the duration or the status and the Phased or Complete switch over the DeploymentLogs steps. The version page of a resource is the VersionDetail template and the deploy drawers opened from these pages are the DeployDrawer template. The Deployments tab of a resource and of a service is the TableView controls row over a deployments table, scoped to the resource (the resource tab adds a small Deployments heading with Documentation and an outlined Deploy action); the service Settings tab is a story of Templates/Platform/Forms/EditResource. Built from `PageHeader`, `PageTabs`, `SectionHeader`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, the platform shell, `Select`, `Tabs`, `TableRoot`, `EmptyState`, `InputGroup`, `Card`, `DropdownMenu`, `Popover`, `Accordion`, `Flow`, `Item`, `Drawer`, `Alert`, `LogView`, `CodeBlock` and `ToggleGroup`.

variants.name: ResourceVersions
variants.summary: The Versions tab of the same resource: the small Versions heading with New Version, the controls row (Filter, search, Refresh, Download CSV, Columns) and the paginated versions table, each row with its code-set name and Latest mark, the comment, the state Tag, who built it and when, and the Open configuration or Deploy actions.

variants.name: ResourceBuild
variants.summary: The Build tab of a resource made from the CLI: the small Build heading with an outlined Deploy, the Git repository band holding the Connect your repository card, the Build configuration band with the read-only framework preset and the build and deploy commands, and the Deployment band with the API token. Editing a command raises the save bar.

variants.name: ServiceOverview
variants.summary: A service: the breadcrumb ends on its environment picker, the outlined Deploy action sits on the tab row, the summary carries its Deployment Settings band (its own environment menu shows only below md, where the breadcrumb is hidden), the production checklist expands into a drawer, and the deployment topology runs from domains to storage with Bind controls on the open Policy and Error Page slots.

variants.name: DeploymentDetail
variants.summary: A deployment that went live: the success banner, the Deployment Details card with every fact and its Deployment Settings band for Default, and the Deployment Logs card with the run duration and the Phased or Complete switch over the phased steps.

variants.name: DeploymentFailed
variants.summary: A deployment the rules rejected: the danger banner with Redeploy, Visit disabled until the deployment is live, and the Deployment Logs card with the Error status, open on the failed step with the rest skipped.
